scenario: LUNI.9.2: any unit symbol answers the annotation, as for LUNI.8.4's products. The author declares the compound dimension `absement` (length × time) with the unit `meter_second`, and `let x: meter_second = integral(f)` compiles. A compiler that gives the read no such answer refuses this with DS_VALIDATE_LET_TYPE_MISMATCH: LUNI.8.6 fails closed on a `ty_unknown` right-hand side. PATH: dsc.validate's `luni_8_6_unit_annotation`, whose `ty_unknown` arm admits the value through `luni_9_2_answered`, which finds the read through dsc.typecheck's `luni_9_2_unit_changing_read` (the call form).
rules_ds:
use default

unit dimension absement storage float64 base meter_second
unit meter_second: absement

schema Flow scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    q: meter mutable

series Flow.q:
    integral sliding 5_min gap zero

rule r:
    Flow f
->
    let x: meter_second = integral(f)
    log info "{x}"
